content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Reno

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree with three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma with five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria and gather documentation of your project leadership background before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's course.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend all sessions synchronously from anywhere, interact with active certified practitioners, and receive official completion documentation. This formal education is the mandatory foundation for your PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, create your PMI account and submit your PMP application directly to the Project Management Institute. Include your work experience details and proof of the 35 contact hours. Pay PMI's exam fee at that time to schedule your examination window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Leverage Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to reinforce key domains and practice question formats. Schedule your proctored exam when ready. The PMP assessment tests your mastery of project-management frameworks and situational judgment across people, processes, and business environments.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, your PMP remains valid for three years. Maintain it by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, conferences, volunteer work, or authoring in project management. Renew your credential and submit your PDU log before expiration to keep your competitive advantage active.
